run_mfg_ppo_experiment: run mean field proximal policy optimization experiment on crowd modelling 2d game with configurable hyperparameters
create_mfg_ppo_agent: create a mean field PPO agent with specified info state size and number of actions on CPU or GPU device
calculate_advantage: calculate advantage function and returns from rollout rewards, values, and done flags using discount factor gamma
calculate_explotability: calculate exploitability metric including Nash convergence for the current MFG policy and distribution
learn_mfg_policy: learn and update MFG PPO policy using rollout history, optimizer, minibatches, epochs, and clipping coefficients
